summary: Painted layers over guides: a keel-painting@1 recipe (palettes, anchor and pin warps, layers of passes on ID selections) and its guide passes (id, light, line) planned in exact arithmetic with a digest, then painted with render/brush: underpainting, block-in, form, detail, accent, blend and glaze passes coloured by ramps of the light, presets for skin, hair locks, cloth and velvet, each layer masked, blended, edge-bled and graded.

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.help: Where every stroke lies in its cell, its size and its colour's wander; the recipe's own seed unless set.
